# Bytebot - Self-Hosted AI Desktop Agent

## Docs

- [Tasks API](https://docs.bytebot.ai/api-reference/agent/tasks.md): Reference documentation for the Bytebot Agent Tasks API
- [Task UI](https://docs.bytebot.ai/api-reference/agent/ui.md): Documentation for the Bytebot Task UI
- [Computer Use API Examples](https://docs.bytebot.ai/api-reference/computer-use/examples.md): Code examples for common automation scenarios using the Bytebot API
- [Unified Computer Actions API](https://docs.bytebot.ai/api-reference/computer-use/unified-endpoint.md): Control all aspects of the desktop environment with a single endpoint
- [API Reference](https://docs.bytebot.ai/api-reference/introduction.md): Overview of the Bytebot API endpoints for programmatic control
- [Agent System](https://docs.bytebot.ai/core-concepts/agent-system.md): The AI brain that powers your self-hosted desktop automation
- [Architecture](https://docs.bytebot.ai/core-concepts/architecture.md): How Bytebot's desktop agent works under the hood
- [Desktop Environment](https://docs.bytebot.ai/core-concepts/desktop-environment.md): The virtual Linux desktop where Bytebot performs tasks
- [Bytebot vs Traditional RPA](https://docs.bytebot.ai/core-concepts/rpa-comparison.md): How Bytebot revolutionizes enterprise automation beyond traditional RPA tools
- [Helm Deployment](https://docs.bytebot.ai/deployment/helm.md): Deploy Bytebot on Kubernetes using Helm charts
- [LiteLLM Integration](https://docs.bytebot.ai/deployment/litellm.md): Use any LLM provider with Bytebot through LiteLLM proxy
- [Deploying Bytebot on Railway](https://docs.bytebot.ai/deployment/railway.md): Comprehensive guide to deploying the full Bytebot stack on Railway using the official 1-click template
- [Password Management & 2FA](https://docs.bytebot.ai/guides/password-management.md): How Bytebot handles authentication automatically using password managers
- [Takeover Mode](https://docs.bytebot.ai/guides/takeover-mode.md): Take control of the desktop when you need to guide or assist Bytebot
- [Task Creation & Management](https://docs.bytebot.ai/guides/task-creation.md): Master the art of creating effective tasks and managing them through completion
- [Introduction](https://docs.bytebot.ai/introduction.md): Open source AI desktop agent that automates any computer task
- [Quick Start](https://docs.bytebot.ai/quickstart.md): Get your AI desktop agent running in 2 minutes
